name: General Exploration Pack
purpose: Pre-orientation exploration — scope discovery, option enumeration, situation assessment, and problem-space mapping before committing to a specific task mode. Covers the common "let me look first / understand the current state / take stock" pattern (Chinese equivalents: 先看看 / 摸清现状 / 梳理一下).
when_to_use: user asks to explore or understand a codebase area before acting
user says let me look first / understand the current state / take stock / scope it (Chinese: 先看看 / 先摸清楚 / 先梳理一下 / 先调研 / 先盘点)
the problem space is ambiguous and needs scoping before committing
user wants options enumerated without premature narrowing
pre-orientation discovery before switching to plan/debug/refactor modes
notes: Domains are intentionally left empty — exploration discovers relevant domains dynamically from codebase context.
When exploration reveals a clear task mode, escalate to the appropriate skill (plan/debug/refactor/etc.).
The pack provides lightweight structure without forcing premature conclusions.
